zh: 合法子串里只发生一次 0/1 切换，所以它一定横跨某个“相邻两段同字符连续段”的分界线，并且只横跨这一条。
把字符串切成同字符的连续段。对一条分界线，左右各取 j 个字符就得到一个合法子串，j 可以取 1 到两段长度的较小值，因此这条分界线贡献 min(左段长, 右段长)。
从左到右扫描，记录上一段长度 previous 和当前段长度 current；遇到新字符时先把 min(previous, current) 加进答案，再令 previous = current、current = 1。扫描结束后再补加最后一对的 min。空串输出 0。
en: A valid substring switches between 0 and 1 exactly once, so it crosses exactly one boundary between two adjacent runs of equal characters.

Split the string into runs of equal characters. Taking j characters on each side of a boundary gives a valid substring for every j from 1 to the shorter of the two runs, so each boundary contributes min(left run length, right run length).

Scan left to right, keeping the previous run length and the current run length. When the character changes, add min(previous, current) to the answer, then set previous = current and current = 1. After the scan, add the min for the last pair as well. An empty string gives 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Split the string into runs of equal characters; each pair of adjacent runs contributes the smaller of their lengths. Sum this over all adjacent pairs.

## Proof of correctness

A valid substring has only one character change, so it crosses exactly one boundary between a pair of adjacent runs. If it takes j characters on each side, the feasible values of j are exactly 1..min(the two run lengths), and different boundaries never count the same substring. The sum is therefore complete and counts nothing twice.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
